name: github
description: GitHub tools: search issues and pull requests, read one with its comments, read a file or list a folder, open an issue and comment.

config.label: Access token
config.hint: A fine-grained personal access token, created at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens. Write it as ${ENV_VAR} to keep it out of the settings file.

config.label: Default repository
config.hint: Optional. Like owner/name. Used when a call names no repository.

config.label: Repositories the agent may change
config.hint: Required to open issues or comment; empty means read only. Comma separated, like owner/name or owner/*, or * for any repository. Searching and reading are never limited by it.

config.label: API address
config.hint: Only for GitHub Enterprise Server, like https://git.example.com/api/v3. Leave empty for github.com.
